description: This file defines the API and data structures for managing file write-locks used by Git. It provides functions to create, manage, and release lockfiles, ensuring mutual exclusion during file updates and automatic cleanup of locks on program exit or signals. The content emphasizes the use of temporary files, atomic renames, and signal handling for safe concurrency control in Git.

classes.name: lock_file
classes.description: Structure representing a lockfile, encapsulating a tempfile used for lock management.

methods.name: hold_lock_file_for_update_timeout_mode
methods.description: Attempts to create a lockfile with a specified timeout and mode, returning a file descriptor or -1 on failure.

methods.name: int hold_lock_file_for_update_timeout(struct lock_file * lk,const char * path,int flags,long timeout_ms)
methods.description: Attempts to create a lockfile with a timeout, using default mode 0666.

methods.name: int hold_lock_file_for_update(struct lock_file * lk,const char * path,int flags)
methods.description: Attempts to create a lockfile without timeout, using default mode.

methods.name: int hold_lock_file_for_update_mode(struct lock_file * lk,const char * path,int flags,int mode)
methods.description: Attempts to create a lockfile with specific mode, without timeout.

methods.name: int is_lock_file_locked(struct lock_file * lk)
methods.description: Checks if the lockfile is currently active/locked.

methods.name: unable_to_lock_message
methods.description: Generates an error message describing why locking a file failed.

methods.name: unable_to_lock_die
methods.description: Emits an error message and terminates the program if locking fails.

methods.name: FILE * fdopen_lock_file(struct lock_file * lk,const char * mode)
methods.description: Associates a stdio stream with the lockfile for reading/writing.

methods.name: const char * get_lock_file_path(struct lock_file * lk)
methods.description: Returns the path to the lockfile.

methods.name: int get_lock_file_fd(struct lock_file * lk)
methods.description: Returns the file descriptor for the lockfile.

methods.name: FILE * get_lock_file_fp(struct lock_file * lk)
methods.description: Returns a FILE* pointer for the lockfile.

methods.name: get_locked_file_path
methods.description: Returns the path of the locked file.

methods.name: int close_lock_file_gently(struct lock_file * lk)
methods.description: Closes the lockfile and its FILE* stream without removing the lock.

methods.name: int reopen_lock_file(struct lock_file * lk)
methods.description: Reopens a lockfile that was closed with `close_lock_file_gently()`.

methods.name: commit_lock_file
methods.description: Closes and atomically renames the lockfile to finalize the lock.

methods.name: int commit_lock_file_to(struct lock_file * lk,const char * path)
methods.description: Renames the lockfile to a specified path upon commit.

methods.name: int rollback_lock_file(struct lock_file * lk)
methods.description: Removes the lockfile, aborting the lock operation.

ctags.name: commit_lock_file_to
ctags.pattern: /^static inline int commit_lock_file_to(struct lock_file *lk, const char *path)$/

ctags.signature: (struct lock_file * lk,const char * path,int flags,int mode)

ctags.signature: (struct lock_file * lk,const char * path,int flags,long timeout_ms)
